moments.author: Elon Musk
moments.quote: Neuralink’s first product is called Telepathy. It enables high‑speed communication with computers or humans simply by thinking. Output bandwidth will vastly exceed the fastest human speech or typing in a few years.
moments.why: Neuralink revealed its brain‑computer implants — huge implications for tech and disability, dominating conversation among men curious about future capabilities.
moments.url: news coverage of Musk’s Neuralink announcement on X

moments.author: Elon Musk
moments.quote: Our second product is called Blindsight and it will … enable even those who are completely blind or have never seen to see. It is ready from an engineering standpoint. Just waiting on regulatory approval.
moments.why: An even more astonishing Neuralink reveal — men are buzzing over the prospect of restoring vision via BCI.
moments.url: news coverage of Musk’s Blindsight announcement on X

moments.author: Jonathan Levin
moments.quote: We assess @binance hack for $6.4 B was likely done by DPRK group TraderTraitor due to links to previous hack. Industry partners have already frozen ~$3B and we @chainalysis continue to follow all of the funds
moments.why: Chainalysis CEO’s X post about the $6B‑plus Binance hack is alarming and viral among men watching crypto/security news.
moments.url: news coverage quoting Levin’s X post on Binance hack attribution

moments.author: Binance (Co‑founder Yi He)
moments.quote: Binance had suspended deposits and withdrawals
moments.why: Confirmation of action taken by Binance amid the hack adds urgency — widely shared in crypto circles.
